notes.title: 2026 general election
notes.text: The Associated Press called the November 3, 2026 race for the open 7th District seat for Republican Michael Alfonso over Democrat Fred Clark on election night. Results stay unofficial until the Wisconsin Elections Commission completes the state canvass, which state law requires on or before December 1, 2026.

notes.title: Change of member on January 3, 2027
notes.text: Rep. Tom Tiffany did not seek re-election to the House in 2026, so the seat was open. The term of the member elected in 2026 begins January 3, 2027, the date the 20th Amendment sets for House terms.

sources.label: WPR results
sources.apa: Wisconsin Public Radio. (2026, November). Wisconsin congressional election results, November 2026.

notes.title: Same lines for the 118th and 119th Congresses
notes.text: Wisconsin did not redraw its congressional map between the 118th and 119th Congresses; the five states that did were Alabama, Georgia, Louisiana, New York, and North Carolina. That is why district estimates from 2022 onward can be compared year to year.
